text: INT. DYLAN'S BEDROOM - DAY1 1

ELSA LOCKHART (20, innocent beauty with mischievous eyes) tiptoes into Dylan's bedroom. She spots a framed photograph on the dresser - her and Dylan when she was 19. She quickly opens the drawer and buries it beneath his clothes. The sound of running water catches her attention. She turns toward the bathroom door, left slightly ajar. Through the steamy glass shower door, DYLAN LANCASTER (36, ruggedly handsome) is showering. Elsa's eyes widen as the water cascades down his muscular frame.

The steam parts as if inviting her. Elsa moves toward the shower in a trance. Her fingertips touch the glass. Dylan turns, noticing her. Instead of surprise, his eyes darken with desire. He slides the shower door open. Elsa steps forward, fully clothed. The water soaks through her thin blouse, revealing her curves. Dylan pulls her against his wet, naked body. His one hand brushes through her body, the other slowly gripping her neck with just the right amount of force. His grip slides down to her thigh as as he presses her against the shower wall. Dylan teases her; he kisses her a sweet second, only to make her want him more. She gasps as he leaves her hanging. As his hand slides between her thighs,
Elsa! What are you doing in my room?
Dylan stands by the shower, with a towel wrapped around his waist, droplets of water still clinging to his chest. His expression is stern, disapproving.
Sorry! I was just... looking for my sweater. Thought it might've gotten mixed in with your laundry.
Where did our camping trip photo go?
That ancient thing? Don't you think it's time for some updated memories?
She moves toward the door, but Dylan blocks her path.
Hold it right there, young lady. Dylan gestures with his eyes at her extremely short skirt. Elsa catches it and sighs, frustrated at Dylan playing conservative dad.
I can literally SEE your underwear.
It's LITERALLY what every girl wears on campus.
I don't give a damn what "every girl" wears. I promised your parents I'd take care of you, and that's exactly what I'm going to do.
Don't bring them up!!! Ever!
Elsa, I didn't mean to upset you.
Whatever. We are not even blood- related. Plus, in case you forgot, in 20 days, I turn 21. I’ll be a grown- up.
A grown-up? Young lady, you've been sneaking around lately. What are you up to, Elsa?
Spoiler: You won’t have to wait long.
She slips past him, leaving Dylan troubled.
INT. UNIVERSITY CLASSROOM - DAY2 2
Dylan, dressed in a tailored suit, strides into the lecture hall. Female students swoon and whisper as he passes. He remains stoic, professional.
Today, we'll be analyzing the psychological underpinnings of Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment, specifically focusing on...
The door opens. All heads turn. ELSA walks in confidently, wearing a form-fitting outfit. She locks eyes with Dylan and smiles sweetly.
Sorry I'm late, Professor. I'm the new transfer student. Dylan is frozen in shock.
INT. UNIVERSITY CLASSROOM - DAY3 3
Sorry I'm late, Professor. I'm the new transfer student. Dylan freezes, his professional demeanor cracking. He tugs at his collar, clears his throat, and forces himself back into professor mode.
Take a seat. We've already started. Elsa smirks, satisfied. She strides toward an empty desk. The

BOYS in class whispers and WOWs at her charm. Across the room, three perfectly polished students — ANNA, MONICA, and LAURA (all early 20s, Instagram-ready) — glare daggers at Elsa. They huddle together, whispering.
Who does she think she is?
Innocent new girl act? Please.

No one flirts with OUR professor and gets away with it. As Elsa passes Anna's desk, Anna’s hand flicks. A blade slices Elsa’s bag. Her books and pens spill across the floor with a loud CLATTER. Dylan turns from the whiteboard, eyebrow raised.
Oops! Sorry I-

She scrambles to collect her belongings. Spotting an empty seat, she hurries over and sits down – not noticing the clear adhesive Monica applied moments earlier. RIIIIIP! Her skirt tears loudly as she stands back up in shock.
Ah!
Is there a problem, Miss Lockhart?
(holding torn skirt discreetly) Nope! Not at all.
The trio exchange smug looks. Dylan returns to his lecture. Elsa sits miserably, trying to hold her skirt together. Later, as class winds down:
Before we wrap up, it's department policy that new transfer students give a brief self-introduction. Miss Lockhart, are you prepared?
Yes, absolutely! While Elsa organizes her notes, Anna deftly swipes Elsa's flash drive from her open bag. Monica slides a replacement into the pile of Elsa's scattered belongings.

Elsa grabs the drive, heads to the front, and plugs it into the computer. She clicks play, then turns to face the class confidently. MOANING sounds fill the room. Elsa spins around to see explicit pornographic images projected on the massive screen behind her. Her face goes white. Students GASP. Some snicker. Others look away, embarrassed.
He slams the laptop shut. The classroom falls silent.
Miss Lockhart. My office. Now!
The mean girl trio celebrates with a synced victory hair flip.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY4 4

Dylan SLAMS into his office, the door banging against the wall. Elsa jumps. He locks the door behind him with a decisive CLICK. He advances on her, towering and intimidating. Elsa backs up until she hits the wall. Dylan plants his hands on either side of her head, caging her in.
Transferring to my department without telling me? And what’s up with that video?
I don’t know why that video is on my flash drive...maybe I grabbed the wrong one...
You're saying you do have porns stash somewhere? Since when? What else have you been hiding from me?
What's your problem?
I'm twenty years old! It's perfectly legal for me to watch whatever I want! Dylan steps back, visibly thrown off balance, his expression shifts. He turns away, running a hand through his hair.
Jesus Christ, Elsa. Elsa quickly slides up behind him and hug him, pressing her cheek against his back.
Why does it bother you so much, Uncle Dylan? Dylan's breathing changes. He goes rigid but doesn't pull away. We can see the conflict playing across his face.
Let go. Now.
No.
This is inappropriate. Let go.

Why? You used to hold me all the time! What changed? Dylan's hand hovers over her arms wrapped around his waist, trembling slightly. For a moment, it looks like he might caress her hand, give in to the touch.
I've made the same wish last year. Do you remember? I said I want to be...
"Uncle Dylan's bride when I grow up."
He abruptly breaks free from her embrace. They both stand there, breathing heavily, faces flushed.
I've grown up now!
No, Elsa. It's not going to happen. That’s not allowed.
Why not? Dylan finally meets her eyes. The tension between them is electric.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY5 5
Dylan sighs, grips Elsa's shoulders, locking eyes with her.
Elsa, we talked about this. I'm way older than you! And now, I'm even your professor...
That's not a reason. That wouldn’t matter if you had loved me! You don’t love me!
Of course I love you... Elsa looks up, as if she sees some hope. But Dylan continues.
As family, as I promised my best friend, your father, before he died. to always protect you and love you- Elsa's expression shifts from hurt to anger. She tries to break free from Dylan’s grip.
If that's what you truly believe... fine. Keep telling yourself that.
She angrily pushes Dylan away, her hand accidentally hitting a framed picture on the wall. The frame falls toward her. Elsa turns, sees it, and screams.
Ah!

Dylan pulls Elsa into a protective embrace. The frame crashes against his back. He winces in pain but doesn't loosen his grip on her. Time seems to freeze for Elsa. All she can see is Dylan's face inches from hers, feeling his warm breath. They're close enough to kiss... Dylan and Elsa remain locked in their embrace, both breathing heavily. It takes a while for both of them to realize what actually happened. Elsa's anger melts into concern as she tries to push his suit aside.
Are you okay? Let me see! Watching her panic, Dylan can't help but smile, affectionately tousling her hair.

Remember your favorite story when you were little? The one with monsters invading the kingdom, where only knights could protect the princess? You'd badger me constantly, "Uncle Dylan, will you be my knight?"
They steady each other as they stand up straight.

Princess's knight —that's where I belong. Elsa stares at his injured shoulder, her lips parting to speak, but she swallows her words. Instead, she tenderly adjusts his clothes, her eyes betraying her concern. Just then, Anna, Monica, and Laura pass by the doorway. Through the gap, they spot Elsa intimately fixing Dylan's clothes. They exchange glances, suspicion written across their faces.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY6 6
Elsa walks down the hallway, looking around with curiosity until,
Someone pushes her from behind. Elsa falls immediately on her knees. It’s Anna, Monica, and Laura. They come around and surround Elsa. Elsa looks up in shock.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY - CONTINUOUS7 7
Anna stands over Elsa, her hand still raised from the push.
Look who it is! Transfer trash, hooking up with Professor Lancaster! Their voices are carrying across the courtyard.
The whole school knows now.
Such a desperate whore! Students stop and stare. Whispers ripple through the crowd. Elsa adjusts herself, confused.
What are you talking about?
Pretend to be innocent. Of course. But I got it all recorded. Anna holds up her phone. On the screen: a video of Elsa and Dylan in an emotional embrace from earlier. Elsa's face goes pale.
That's... not what it looks like—
Don’t bother explain, SLUT!
Pathetic. Can’t even pass a class without turning office hours into after hours.

Their words catch on like wildfire —more voices from the crowd joined in, spitting insults. Someone hurl trash at her. VERONICA FISHER (32, stunning, sophisticated and radiating authority) approaches through the crowd. Anna, Monica and Laura phony stops, with kiss-up smiles on their faces.
Professor Fisher! We didn’t know you are around...
P...Professor! Help! These students are trying to insult and bully me! Veronica looks around at the situation.
True. Students who cross boundaries need to learn their place. Elsa finally relaxes and lets out a deep breath. Suddenly, Veronica walks up to her, stepping on her hand with her high heel.
I mean YOU. Elsa’s eyes widen, screams. She can’t believe what’s happening.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY - CONTINUOUS8 8
Veronica lifts her heel off Elsa's hand, enjoying her pain.
Oops. Slipped. Anna, Monica, and Laura laughs out.
Not your fault, professor. They should clean up the trash.
This piece of trash tried to seduce YOUR Professor Lancaster on her first day! She deserves more.
Everyone knows you and Professor Lancaster are perfect together!
What? No, Dylan will never date... But they won’t let her finish. Three mean girls kick her with knee, snatch her bag, and pull her hair.
Ah! Stop! Elsa hurts all over and can’t lift her head. ELSA(CONT'D) How dare you!!! I’m reporting this to the principal!
Oh yes, we should. Suddenly, Principal Robertson appears around the corner, approaching the group.
What’s the chaos here?
Principal Robertson! Please! Help! Veronica immediately drops to the floor, clutching her arm dramatically. Principal Robertson sees this and immediately gets furious.
What is this? Explain!
INT. HALLWAY - DAY - CONTINUOUS9 9
Principal! This student just attacked me! She's crazy!
What! How dare you!
I...I...didn’t...
INT. CAMPUS - DAY10 10
Meanwhile, Dylan frantically dials Elsa's number. It goes straight to voicemail.
Come on, Elsa. Pick up...
Did you hear that the newbie blew up the hallway?
Damn!
He runs away.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY11 11
Assaulting faculty? Inappropriate behavior with professors? Call your parents immediately!
She doesn't have parents. That's probably why she acts like this. Let me discipline her. I know how to deal with troubled girls.
Your family's contribution to this school is invaluable. Whatever you think is best.
The Principal leaves. It’s just Veronica and the trio. Elsa backs against the wall, fear in her eyes as Veronica signals to Anna, Monica, and Laura.
Time to teach her some respect. Rip off her clothes!
The three girls advance menacingly toward Elsa.
Let’s livestream this so the whole school can see how this filthy whore throws herself around in public!
They start to take off her jewelry, rip off her clothes. Elsa fights back but is helpless.
Let me go! You bitches! Let me go! Just then, Dylan rushes over and stands in front of Elsa.
Elsa looks at him with tear-filled, desperate eyes.
INT. HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS12 12
Great pain is seen in Dylan’s eyes. But he tries to keep calm in front of others. Veronica looks at Dylan with mock concern.
Protecting a student who's been seducing you? Not very professional, Dylan. Dylan stops. He can only watch Elsa on the ground, but force his expression into cold professionalism.
Handling a situation like this here is not very professional either. Veronica links her arm through his possessively.
You're absolutely right. Let's discuss this privately. Elsa stares at Dylan in disbelief.
Are you agreeing with her? You think I should be expelled too?
You go home. Now. Elsa's face crumbles. She turns and walks away, shoulders shaking.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY13 13
Dylan looks at Veronica anxiously, while she wears nothing but a proud, smug smile.
That video was a misunderstanding. Don't expel Elsa. Hold me accountable.
Awww. Very touching.
Veronica. Please. Veronica tilted her head back, leaning closer to Dylan. She trails her fingers along his shoulder seductively.
(circling him aggressively) You know, her future is fully in your hands.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY - CONTINUOUS14 14
Veronica’s fingers continues to savor him, under pressure.
Date me. Out loud. In front of everyone. Then, your little girl stays. No? Then, she disappears. Poof.
She presses him closer, smiles.
You know we are meant to be, right?
Veronica, this isn’t right.
Oh really? Fine. She’s gone. Dylan closes his eyes in defeat.
What the hell do you want from me...
EXT. UNIVERSITY GATES - DAY15 15
Elsa clutches her books and supplies, tears streaming down her face. She looks back at the beautiful campus.
Sorry Mom and Dad. I failed you. Principal Robertson approaches her.
Miss Lockhart. Elsa raises her head in shock.
Principal!
Well, your expulsion has been reversed. You're reinstated. But, you better behave yourself. Elsa wipes her tears, face lighting up.
Really?! Thank you so much!
As Principal Robertson leaves, she looks at campus in joy.

It has to be Dylan! He saved me! I’m gonna find him and say thanks. Just then, Dylan and Veronica appear at the gate- his jacket on her shoulder, their arms crossed. Seeing Elsa in the distance, Veronica pulls Dylan close and straightens his tie with deliberate intimacy. From Elsa’s POV, they are kissing; her eyes burn in jealousy. Dylan keeps his eyes forward, nodding at Veronica’s jokes. Veronica stares at Elsa with a triumphant smile. They slip into a luxury car, laughter echoing as it pulls away. Elsa stands alone, her brief joy completely destroyed.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT16 16
The living room is lit only by a small lamp. Elsa sits curled on the couch. The clock shows 11:42 PM. Dylan enters, slightly disheveled, his movements careful but unsteady. He reeks faintly of wine.
Had fun?
Your expulsion’s been overturned. Go to bed. You’ve got class.
Where were you? With her?
That's nothing something a little girl should be asking a far older adult.
A little girl ? Is that all I am to you?
That's what you're supposed to be. Elsa steps closer, her voice breaking.
So you can get all cozy with that evil woman, but when I need you—
Elsa, don’t... you know it’s completely different...
What do I know? I’m just A LITTLE
Elsa turns away sharply, her hand accidentally striking his injured shoulder. Dylan winces, a sharp intake of breath. Elsa's anger dissolves instantly. She turns back, horrified.
God, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...
She rushes to him, carefully examining his shoulder.
Let me see. Is it getting worse?
It’s alright-
They almost speak at the same time and their faces are inches apart as she tries to inspect the wound. But Elsa gets tripped by a pillow and falls towards Dylan.
The two fall to the sofa. Their lips accidentally brush. Both freeze, startled by the contact. Heart pounding. Dylan looks away.
You saw it today... It’s dangerous to be with me.
He carefully looks up only to find heartbreak in Elsa’s eyes.
I don’t care! Everyone in my family have left me... You promised that you'd always be with me... With vulnerable eyes, she pulls Dylan a little closer.
Are you gonna leave me too? Dylan's expression shifts, something breaking behind his eyes. His resolve crumbles.
He caresses her cheek, stares into her teary eyes, then kisses her deeply. As if he would never let her go.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS17 17

Dylan and Elsa collapse into the sofa, mouths locked, embrace getting more intense. Dylan’s hand finds her waist, her body urging him closer. But just as the moment crests, he tears away—eyes clouded with turmoil.
(breathless, fighting his feelings) Elsa... we can’t...I can’t. Elsa stares at him looking for the answer, then smiles.
It’s okay. I can wait. I’m not going anywhere anyways, right? Elsa nonchalantly gives the bandages to Dylan and walks away.
EXT. CAMPUS - DAY18 18
Elsa walks with classmates. Dylan passes by. She turns, her face lighting up with a happy lively smile.
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY19 19
In class, students hunched over test papers. Elsa carefully slips Dylan a neatly folded note. His expression: torn between duty and desire.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY20 20
Dylan discusses with other professors. Elsa sneaks up, taps his shoulder, then skips away with childlike joy. He turns, watching her go with a mixture of tenderness and torment.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - ELSA’S BEDROOM - NIGHT21 21
Elsa writes in her journal, voice-over as we see her writing with dreamy expression.
He keeps pushing me away, but... every glance, every touch says otherwise. Maybe it’s complicated... but it’s worth holding onto.
Dylan is about to refuse but Veronica gives him a threatening look. Dylan sighs and stays quiet. Veronica approaches Elsa.
Since Dylan treats you like his little sister, maybe I'll be your sister-in-law soon. Elsa's face burns with humiliation and rage.
Go to hell.
She storms off. Dylan instinctively moves to follow.
Behave. You know what I can do.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY22 22
Elsa perched innocently on the edge of Dylan's desk while he tries to grade papers, visibly distracted by her presence.
(concerned, checking the door) Elsa, I told you. Not here!
Why? I can’t come and ask about my assignment?
It assembly. If someone notices you’re gone- He’s cutting off. Footsteps approach. A knock at the door.
Mr.Lancaster? Do you have a moment? Dylan and Elsa freeze, panic washing over their faces. Dylan's protective instinct immediately kicks in.
What do we do?
They looks around in panic.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - CONTINUOUS23 23
Principal Robertson enters the office. Dylan sits up straight at his desk, posture unusually stiff. Unbeknownst to Principal Robertson, Elsa is hidden beneath Dylan’s desk.

Dylan, perfect timing! The board just confirmed we'll be hosting the British Literature symposium next month. Dylan nods, trying to maintain composure as he subtly adjusts his position to better conceal Elsa.
That's... wonderful news, Principal Robertson. A great opportunity for our students.

Indeed! We'll need you to prepare a presentation on modern interpretations of Victorian literature. You’re ideal for this. Under the desk, Elsa mischievously observes Dylan's legs. With playful curiosity, she gently touches the area around his thighs. Dylan jolts visibly, as if shocked by electricity.
I-I'd be h-happy to... to contribute. Victorian l-literature is... is... Principal Robertson studies Dylan's face with concern.
Dylan, you look flushed. Are you feeling alright? Dylan grips the edge of his desk, forcing a smile while silently fuming. We can imagine what Elsa is doing right now.
Just a bit warm in here. Nothing to worry about. Please, continue... Principal Robertson is unconvinced but wraps up regardless.
I'll email you the details. Take good care of yourself, will you?

The door closes. Dylan immediately pushes back his chair, lifts Elsa from under the desk and places her on top of it, his expression a mixture of frustration and affection. His face is extremely close to Elsa’s.
Do you understand how much trouble we could both be in?
You said the same thing last time, when we kissed in that empty classroom.
I SAID no talking about that. And that was an accident, too.
Sure sure. Anyway, it’s my 21st birthday soon! I have something special for you! Dylan's expression softens, unable to stay upset with her.
Before he answers, Veronica appears at the doorway, a smirk spreading across her face as she observes them.
Am I interrupting something? Dylan and Elsa turn toward her, frozen in place.
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY24 24
Veronica stares at Elsa in cold smile.
Still trying to seduce your teacher, sweetie? Dylan ushers Elsa out of the office. Elsa leaves with worry.
She’s been asking about her assignment. That’s all-
I'm so disappointed in you, Dylan. Still tangled up with that little child.
She moves closer, her voice turning dangerous.
Don’t fool yourself — the expulsion isn’t forgotten. And don't think I haven't seen your little tricks on campus.
She pulls out a USB drive, dangling it like a weapon.
The evidence is still in my hands. Next time, what could it be? She trails her finger down his chest as she speaks.
I'll completely destroy her. She's only twenty. You couldn't bear to watch that happen, could you?
Please, don't do this to Elsa.
That depends entirely on your performance, honey.
She leans closer, her breath on his ear.
INT. HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS25 25
Elsa tries to press her ear against the door.
From where she stood, Veronica’s silhouette overlapped perfectly with Dylan’s. Their bodies were far too close, Veronica’s head tilting, exactly like they are kissing.
What are they doing...
INT. DYLAN'S OFFICE - DAY26 26
Dylan shoves Veronica away with force.
Please.
She staggered but didn’t look the slightest bit upset. Instead, that fatal smile lingered on her lips.
Next time I’ll kiss you for real.
She takes one step back.
I want you to be absolutely clear with her. No mixed signals, no hope, no room for fantasy.
Her fingers trace his jawline with the USB drive.
I’m sure you can do that.
Of course.
INT. HALLWAY - DAY27 27
Elsa is holding her breath, still trying to sneak a glance. The door suddenly swings open. Veronica emerges. She steps closer, smirks. Her eyes deliberately scan Elsa's body, stopping at her chest.
Young lady, get real. What kind of man would want... this?
She gestures dismissively at Elsa's flat chest.
Real women have something to offer. Elsa's face burns red. Veronica saunters away, leaving Elsa standing there, humiliated and shaking.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - ELSA'S BEDROOM - NIGHT28 28
Elsa is putting on a short top that accentuates her chest.
She’s wrong...she’s wrong!
She looks into the mirror and adjusts her chest carefully.
I can do it.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT29 29
Dylan sits in the couch. He freezes when he sees Elsa comes downstairs with her short top. His jaw drops.
What the hell are you wearing?
Is there a problem?
You're not leaving this house in that. Go change. Now.
Elsa walks towards him, slowly pressing her body against his.
Hmm. Maybe... you’re right. This top is so tight, it's cutting off my circulation. Can you help me see if it's too small... right here?
She guides his hand toward her chest. Dylan jerks back, horrified.
Elsa, what are you doing... Mid-sentence, Elsa's eyes roll back. She collapses.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS30 30
location: INT DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

text: Dylan cradles Elsa's limp body, panic.
Elsa! Are you ok? Suddenly, Elsa's arms snake around his neck. Her eyes flutter open, a wicked smile spreading across her lips.
Got you. Dylan's relief instantly transforms to fury.
It wasn’t funny. He tries to push her away, but Elsa's grip tightens around his waist like a vice.
I KNEW it! You care about me!
Nonsense. Let go of me! Elsa presses closer, her hand flat against his racing heart.
No, Dylan. FEEL it...
She traces her finger down his chest. Dylan's breathing hitches despite himself.
That’s WANT. You WANT me.
She releases him and skips away like nothing happened, leaving Dylan standing there, shaken.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - ELSA'S BEDROOM - NIGHT31 31
Elsa stands by a mirror in a fancy dress, excited and nervous.
21st birthday! Finally! Tonight changes everything. Tonight, I give him all of me.
She applies a final touch of lipstick. She hears movements from downstairs.
Dylan! I'm ready for my birthday surprise!
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT32 32

Elsa walks toward the living room joyfully but freezes at the entrance. Her expression shifts from anticipation to horror. From her perspective: Dylan is bent over on the couch, his head lowered toward Veronica who lies beneath him. Their position suggests intimacy. Elsa gasps involuntarily. The sound makes Dylan look up. Their eyes meet across the room – his filled with panic, hers with devastation.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS33 33
location: INT DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

text: Elsa stands frozen. Her voice cracks with betrayal.
What the hell is this, Dylan? What the fuck are you doing?! Dylan slowly stands, his face a mask of cold indifference. Veronica remains draped across the couch.
Exactly what it looks like. Veronica is my girlfriend.
You're lying to me! After everything happened —
Nothing happened between us, Elsa. Whatever that was was never real. Elsa staggers backward as if slapped.
You are just a child. Sorry if you misunderstood. Elsa's face crumples. Without another word, she turns and
BOLTS for the door.
(instinctively stepping forward) Elsa, wait- Veronica's manicured hand shoots out, gripping his wrist like a shackle.
Remember our deal, darling. The show must go on, or that girl's academic career dies tomorrow.
She glides to the bar, pouring two glasses of wine with theatrical elegance. Dylan stares at the door Elsa fled through, his jaw working. Veronica presses a wine glass into his trembling hand.
EXT. PARK - NIGHT34 34
Elsa collapses on a bench, gasping for air. Her perfect birthday dress is wrinkled, her makeup streaked with tears.
How could I be so stupid? So fucking STUPID! Fucking childish!
She doubles over, clutching her stomach like she's been gutted. Footsteps echo in the darkness. A low, menacing voice cuts through the night.
What do we have there?
Looks like a pretty little thing all alone... Elsa slowly stands up and scans the shadows. Two dark figures emerge from behind the trees.
The figure lunges forward. Elsa screams desperately.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT35 35
Dylan paces like a caged animal, constantly glancing at his watch. Veronica lounges on the couch, amused.
Relax, darling. She’s probably having lots of fun.
Fuck this. I’m going after her.

He strides toward the door. But immediately, he freezes at the door. He sees two figures approach. Elsa is being half-carried by ANDY HAY(22, golden college boy). Her hair is a mess, dress torn at the shoulder.
What the HELL -Get off her! Without warning, Dylan RIPS Elsa from Andy's arms, clutching her against his chest like she's made of glass. DYLAN(CONT'D) Who are you? What did you do to her?
Whoa, dude! I helped her! Found her being harassed by some creeps in the park—
Dylan, stop it! He saved me!
She struggles weakly against Dylan's iron grip.
Let me GO! Don't act like you care!
Elsa, this is not the time for that...
(voice rising, getting breathless) You already made your choice! So don’t YOU dare-
Her eyes roll back. Her body goes limp in Dylan's arms.
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - ELSA'S BEDROOM - NIGHT36 36
Dylan paces by the window, his hair is disheveled.
Doctor, are you sure? Just shock and fever?

She gets fragile because of her childhood illness but she’ll be fine. She’s just shaken up and completely exhausted. Dylan hangs up, slumping against the wall. A soft moan breaks the silence. Elsa tosses restlessly, kicking off her blanket. Sweat beads on her forehead.
No...no... Dylan rushes to her side, gently pulling the blanket back up.
It's okay. Elsa, you're safe now. Elsa's hand reaches out blindly, searching.
Dylan...Where are you... Dylan's mask crumbles. He can't hold back anymore.
I'm here, baby. I'm right here.
He climbs onto the bed, pulling her into his arms.
You promised...you’ll be with me...
Yes, I’ll be with you. Forever. Elsa melts into his embrace. He watches her sleep, then presses a tender kiss to her forehead.
If only I could keep that promise...
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - ELSA'S BEDROOM - MORNING37 37
Elsa's eyes flutter open. Dylan's jacket is draped over her like a blanket. She sits up, touching the fabric.
He actually stayed all night...
INT. DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY - CONTINUOUS38 38
location: INT DYLAN’S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY

text: Elsa finds Dylan setting breakfast on the table. His walls are back up - cold, professional. Dylan sees her, apparently embarrassed.
You’re up. Breakfast is ready. Elsa stares at him. But Dylan is avoiding her.
Don't be stupid again. Running off could've gotten you killed. Elsa isn't buying his attitude. She walks straight up to him.
Cut the bullshit, UNCLE Dylan.
She grabs his tie, yanking him down until their faces are inches apart.
Your words lie, but your body never.
She pulls him even closer, as if they are about to kiss.
What are you doing? Elsa doesn’t answer but staring at him. Her hands trail down his chest slowly. She presses closer, wrapping her leg around his.
Where did you learn this kind of...
